en: The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.$B$BIf you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.
Back to the drawing board.
Crimson Templar!  I hold your crest of beckoning.  Heed my summons!
Follow me, $n. I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better protect me or I am as good as dead.

Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.
Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.
Looks like you'll have to go ahead to Ratchet and tell Sputtervalve that I've wrecked the shredder.
How many of our Lieutenants are alive, Drek'Thar?
Humbug!  Die!
Hold the line!  Protect the King at all costs!
The Scourge infestation grows in the Eastern Plaguelands. Every able bodied warrior is needed to stem the tide of their invasion.$B$BNumber of Necropolises remaining: $2282W
%s takes aim one last time...
%s pauses and looks across the sea of soldiers that stand nervously before him.
Thank... you...
%s listens to $n's plea.

Very well, let your journey of tailoring begin.
You seek death?
A dangerous device this is, $n.  I am glad you brought it to my attention.
Ah, here it is.
This isn't fair!  My dearest Sully!  Come back to me!  No, $n!  Why did you bring me such news!
I wish you a happy holiday, friend!
All present and accounted for, SIR!

Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.
Home again, home again.
I can show you a few tricks... if you don't mind doing a little something first, that is.
You're joking, right? I believe you're looking for the OTHER short fellow, Thonys Pillarstone. He's downstairs. Now skedaddle!
Mother, oh mother.  You should have listened to me...
Wow, this one is just plain useless. Let me try again.
Business must be good down at the bazaar.  I'll get him resupplied right away!
I love you too :).
Your life is forfeit!

Hail, $c.  The Ironforge Brigade is stationed here to keep an eye on Hive'Zora.  The Cenarion Circle druids have been monitoring silithid movement and they're anticipating something major in this area.
Face me, if you dare!
Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.
Feralas: A History... Hmmmm... Let me examine this for a moment.
Time to take out the trash!
The Cenarion Circle is wise, and has delved into many of earth's secrets.  Craftsmen would do well to heed the words of these druids.

Because you have aided me, I will tell you what I know of this land and of the things there are to see. My knowledge is not vast, but perhaps I can point out some things that might interest one such as yourself.
Why would you ever want to harm me!? Come. Friends we can be!
%s begins to channel his energy, focusing on the stone.
Oh!!! Get that thing away from me!
Begone, uncouth scum!  The Alliance shall prevail in Alterac Valley!
